title: 鲸鱼在水里怎么呼吸
subtitle: 头顶上有个喷气孔
character: wearing a navy blue windbreaker, grey trousers and a red life vest, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, oil pastel drawing with thick waxy strokes and blunt smudged edges, deep sea blue, pale grey and bright teal

pages.zh:
我们坐船去看鲸。
海面上先冒出
一根白白的柱子，
又高又直。
爸爸说，它在那儿。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy at the rail of a small boat at sea, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, excited, wind in his hair.

pages.zh:
白柱子底下，
浮起一道黑背，
又长又滑，
慢慢从水里升上来，
又慢慢沉下去。
pages.scene: One long dark whale back rising above the sea surface on a cream background, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鲸长得像鱼，
可它不是鱼。
它和我们一样用肺，
生下来就是小宝宝，
还要喝妈妈的奶。

鱼长着鳃，
泡在水里就能呼吸。
鲸没有鳃。
它的鼻孔搬了家，
搬到了头顶上。

所以它换气的时候，
不用把整个头抬起来。
只要把头顶
露出水面一点点，
就够用了。
pages.scene: One whale at the sea surface on a cream background with only the top of its head showing above the water. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
换气分两步。
先噗的一声，
把憋久的废气喷出去，
再张开那个孔，
吸一大口新的。

喷出来的那根柱子，
不是海里的水。
是肚子里的热气
一碰到冷空气，
变成的白雾。
pages.scene: Close view of a whale blowhole on a cream background with a tall column of white mist bursting upward out of it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我憋气能憋多久？
数到六十就难受了。
海豚能憋十分钟。
抹香鲸下去一趟，
一个多小时才上来。

它为什么憋这么久？
因为它要一直潜到
很深很黑的地方，
去抓住在那里的
大鱿鱼吃。
pages.scene: One sperm whale swimming downward in deep dark water on a cream background, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它睡觉也不能全睡。
睡死了会忘记上浮。
所以它一次
只睡半边脑子，
另外半边替它守着。

小鲸刚生下来，
第一件事不是吃奶。
是妈妈用头托着它，
送到水面上，
吸进第一口气。
pages.scene: One whale mother nudging a small newborn whale up towards the water surface on a cream background, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我趴在船边等。
又一根白柱子。
它一辈子住在海里，
可每一口气，
都得到水面上来拿。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy leaning on the boat rail watching the sea, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, calm and happy.
